After region evidence, cost preparation jointly for storage, ingest, schedulable topology, pruning, encoded work and merge. Cover small, wide-text, large-numeric, dictionary-heavy, unknown-row-count and constrained-memory planner inputs.

Validate same-source durable ingestion, single-file integrity/atomicity and first/repeated downstream use for every retained writer change. Apply the existing size/ingest/query gate and preserve source validation, statistics and no-fallback evidence.

Certify read/transform/retain-or-spill/reconsume/write/reopen across formats, renamed schemas, distributions and remaining types/operators. Include held-out ingest/aggregate/relational/ownership/serving cases, source/type/destination combinations and wide/deep plans after their mechanisms; every exposed composition is tested or an explicit implementation gap.
Pin eligible ClickBench scoring/cohorts separately from cached product sessions; preserve one-call Full43 acceptance versus explicitly authorized repeated comparative cohorts.

After a newly admitted topology mechanism, compare current/coarse and safe small/medium/large topology on identical immutable 100M-row input, build and resources. Preserve the original 129-call comparative protocol and classify scan/reduction/filter/grouped/ordered/global-state response with realized/pruned/materialized work; do not restart rejected coalescing without a new mechanism.

Prove ordinary and benchmark resource envelopes, late failure, slow consumers, cancellation, cleanup/recovery and actual supported OS/architecture runtimes. Record observed resources/RSS and scoped support, known issues, compatibility, upgrade/rollback and install evidence; builds alone are not platform-runtime acceptance.

Record complete outputs, paired uncertainty and non-ClickBench benefit for retained performance changes; separate engine clocks from transport/ingest/storage and preserve all failures and samples. CG-5/6 and claim gates remain mandatory.

Establish material remaining instruction/dispatch cost, then freeze representative/held-out training, compilation/transfer break-even and portable-package correctness gates. Retain PGO only on measured complete-workflow benefit; otherwise record the drop.

Write the pinned-provider RFC/review: native wire/encoding/schema versions, registry/alignment/message duplication, query/partition/snapshot identity, completion/truncation, cancel/reconnect/replay and deterministic strict-native incompatibility. Define authentication, per-request authorization and transport security using established infrastructure.

Define queue/receive/dictionary grants and exact identity, release/eviction, lifetime and isolation rules. Evaluate buffer/dictionary reuse and same-host mapped handles only with explicit rights/cleanup; version aggregate state separately and keep in-process handles distinct from serialization.

Implement a bounded producer → transport → receiver → real downstream native operation with equivalent semantics/security/resources and complete error/cleanup behavior. Freeze and measure wire bytes, sender/receiver CPU, copies/materialization, memory and complete downstream cost against optimized Arrow/Flight and ordinary Vortex IPC.

Prove ordinary Flight SQL client interoperability and explicit native client selection, then align README, field guide, capabilities, execution evidence and hosted checks before closing only the accepted scope.
